# Software engineering

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `engineering`  
**Mission:** Ship maintainable, secure, tested software in small reviewed increments.

## Startup stage

One or two full-stack engineers cover frontend, backend, API, mobile and documentation. Code review still happens: the independent code-reviewer agent or a second human reads every diff.

## Agents operating in this department

`engineering-lead`, `backend-engineer`, `frontend-engineer`, `technical-writer`, `code-reviewer`, `documentation-auditor`

## Roles

### Frontend engineer

Role id: `frontend-engineer`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Implement accessible, responsive UI that matches the spec, with proof from the browser. |
| Scope of responsibility | Web UI, components, state, accessibility, performance of the client. |
| Core activities | Implement from tokens and specs; Handle all states; Verify in browser at viewports; Write component and e2e tests |
| Inputs | Design package; Tokens; API contract |
| Outputs and deliverables | UI code; Tests; Screenshots |
| Decisions it can make | Implementation details within spec |
| Decisions requiring approval | Spec deviations by design lead |
| Collaborating roles | design; backend; qa |
| Reporting relationship | engineering-lead |
| KPIs | Design QA defects; Accessibility defects; Performance budget |
| Quality expectations | Semantic HTML; no fake data; keyboard and contrast verified |
| Tools and resources | Browser; Test runner; Linters |
| Common failure modes | Missing states; Hard-coded values; Unverified rendering |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | None |

### API engineer

| Decisions requiring approval | Breaking changes by engineering lead |

| KPIs | Contract test pass; Breaking changes; Error rate |

| Tools and resources | API design template |
